name: squawkflow
description: Read-only, dated market structure data: SPX, SPY and QQQ dealer gamma levels (GEX) and the gamma grid, the sector gamma matrix, the exchange calendar of sessions and expirations, the VIX futures settlement curve, SPX max pain, CFTC futures positioning and 13F filing receipts from SEC EDGAR. Every figure carries its source and as-of time. No account, no key, no advice and no predictions.

interface.longDescription:
SquawkFlow answers market structure questions with numbers that carry a date and a source.

Ask where the SPX call wall, put wall and zero gamma flip sit, whether the index is in a positive or negative gamma regime, how dealer gamma is spread by strike and expiration for SPX, SPY and QQQ, or ask when the next monthly or quarterly options expiration is, whether the exchange is open on a given day, whether the VIX futures curve is in contango or backwardation, where SPX max pain sits for an expiration, how asset managers and leveraged funds are positioned in stock index futures, or what a fund reported in its latest 13F filing and when it was filed.

Every figure comes from a named public or derived source (SquawkFlow's own gamma computation from settled exchange open interest, the official exchange holiday calendars, settled VIX futures, the delayed options chain, the CFTC Traders in Financial Futures report, SEC EDGAR), with its capture or settlement time and a link to the page it is published on. If a source fails, SquawkFlow gives the last good reading with its as-of time rather than a remembered number.

SquawkFlow is read-only and needs no account. It does not give investment advice, does not make predictions or price targets, and places no orders.

positive.description: SPX dealer gamma levels and regime
positive.prompt: Where are the SPX call wall, put wall and zero gamma flip right now, and is the index in a positive or negative gamma regime?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_gex_levels for SPX. Answers with the call wall, put wall and zero gamma flip as dated figures, states the positive or negative gamma regime, and names the source (SquawkFlow's own gamma computation from settled open interest) with the as-of time. No forecast and no advice.

positive.description: QQQ gamma by strike and expiration
positive.prompt: Show me QQQ dealer gamma broken out by strike and expiration.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_gamma_heatmap with symbol QQQ. Summarizes where gamma concentrates by strike and by expiration, in dollars per 1% move, with the source and the as-of time of the grid. Descriptive only.

positive.description: Next monthly expiration and session status
positive.prompt: When is the next monthly options expiration, and is the market open on December 25, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_market_calendar with date 2026-12-25. States whether that date is an exchange session, the next session after it, and the next monthly expiration date, citing the published exchange calendar document and the as-of time.

positive.prompt: Is the VIX futures curve in contango or backwardation today?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_vix_term_structure. Reports the settled monthly VIX futures prices, says whether the curve is in contango or backwardation, and gives the settlement date and source. No prediction.

positive.prompt: How are asset managers and leveraged funds positioned in S&P 500 futures according to the CFTC?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_positioning. Reports the CFTC Traders in Financial Futures net positions by trader class, with the Tuesday measurement date and the Friday publication date, and links the source page. Descriptive only.

negative.description: Order placement request. Expected: the app has no order tools and calls none; it says it is read-only and cannot place trades, and offers dated market structure data instead.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 SPX calls for me at the money.

negative.description: Price target or forecast request. Expected: the app declines to predict, calls no forecasting tool, and offers the current dated gamma levels and calendar as descriptive context.
negative.prompt: What will the S&P 500 close at tomorrow? Give me a price target.

negative.description: Personal investment advice request. Expected: the app declines to give advice, does not tell the user what to buy or sell, and stays descriptive by pointing to dated figures with sources.
negative.prompt: I have $50,000 saved. Should I put it in SPY calls or QQQ?

review.commerce_description: No products are sold and no payments are processed.
